Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the series catalysts display similar characteristics except (Pt0.9Pd0.1)3Fe/C. For (Pt0.9Pd0.1)3Fe/C, extra super-lattice diffraction peaks appear in the XRD pattern, such as the peaks located at 32.68, 52.82, and 58.33°, indicating the formation of the L12 intermetallic structure. Especially the pronounced diffraction peak at 32.68°, corresponding to the (110) plane of (Pt0.9Pd0.1)3Fe/C, matches well with the standard card (JCPDS: Pt3Fe # 01-089-2050). The microstructure of the (Pt0.9Pd0.1)3Fe/C catalyst was characterized by TEM and STEM. An atomic resolution image (Figure 1i) of (Pt0.9Pd0.1)3Fe/C along the [100] zone axis clearly exhibits a standard ordered fcc structure, apparent characteristics of the ordered atom arrangement.
